info.name: AdoptApp Full Enterprise API
info.description: Complete API collection for AdoptApp microservices architecture. Based on actual source code analysis.

variable.description: ADMIN user. Also available: StacyBakr (SHELTER_ADMIN), LisaS (ADOPTER), volunteer1 (VOLUNTEER), dr.hibbert (VET)
ADMIN password. Non-admin users use: password123

request.description: Get all users with optional status filter. Roles: ADOPTER, VOLUNTEER, VET, SHELTER_ADMIN, ADMIN
Get user by ID. Roles: ADOPTER, VOLUNTEER, VET, SHELTER_ADMIN, ADMIN
Get user by email. Authenticated users.
Get user history. Role: ADMIN only.
Create a new user. Roles: ADOPTER, SHELTER_ADMIN, VOLUNTEER, VET, ADMIN. Returns 201.
Update user by ID. Uses @userSecurity.canEdit SpEL expression.
Delete user by ID. Role: ADMIN only. Returns 204.

Get shelter by ID. Roles: ADOPTER, VOLUNTEER, VET, SHELTER_ADMIN, ADMIN
Get shelter history. Role: ADMIN only.

query.description: Required query param: user ID of the shelter admin

request.description: Create a new shelter. Requires userId query param. Roles: SHELTER_ADMIN, ADMIN. Returns 201.
Update shelter by ID. Requires userId query param. Roles: SHELTER_ADMIN, ADMIN.

Create a new pet. Roles: ADOPTER, SHELTER_ADMIN, VOLUNTEER, ADMIN. Returns 201.
